exact_formula: t_commit-first t>=t_anchor with p(t)>=0.80 for 3 consecutive frames; value=t_commit-t_anchor
hysteresis: depart threshold 0.10; commit remains valid until p<0.70
physical_interpretation: Time from frozen intent anchor to durable arrival in target-lane side
expected_noise_sensitivity: Raw projection jitter may change one frame but 3-frame dwell prevents one-frame commitment
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Thresholds are physical seconds at dt=0.1; resample duration not frame count
edge_cases: invalid p frame; low-speed transition; no commitment by horizon; map ambiguity
rationale: 0.10 and 0.80 are lane-geometry fractions; 0.3 s is three 0.1 s samples

exact_formula: t_commit-first t>=t_anchor with median3 p(t)>=0.75 for 5 consecutive frames; value=t_commit-t_anchor
hysteresis: depart threshold 0.10; commitment exits only below 0.65
physical_interpretation: More tolerant target arrival definition with longer persistence
expected_noise_sensitivity: Lower response to isolated p jitter but more sensitive to sustained lane-projection bias
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Five frames equal 0.5 s at dt=0.1 and must be converted by seconds
edge_cases: edge windows without median3; low speed; no commitment; missing map projection
rationale: Longer persistence trades temporal precision for repeatability

exact_formula: t_commit-first t>=t_anchor with median5 p(t)>=0.90 for 2 consecutive frames; value=t_commit-t_anchor
hysteresis: depart threshold 0.15; commitment exits only below 0.80
physical_interpretation: Strict near-centerline target occupancy with short confirmation
expected_noise_sensitivity: Median5 suppresses high-frequency jitter but can delay a sharp transition
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Two frames equal 0.2 s while median5 spans 0.5 s; both scale in seconds
edge_cases: edge windows; narrow or changing lane width; unfinished transition
rationale: High target fraction emphasizes completed lane occupancy rather than onset

exact_formula: count disjoint episodes after p>=0.15 and before first commitment where dp/dt<=-0.15 per s for 2 frames and cumulative fall>=0.10
minimum_duration: 0.2 s negative-rate onset and 0.3 s minimum episode
hysteresis: enter retreat at -0.15 per s; exit only after dp/dt>=0.05 per s for 2 frames; merge gaps below 0.3 s
physical_interpretation: Counts physically material backwards motion before recommit
expected_noise_sensitivity: Direct p differences are sensitive to map projection noise; cumulative fall prevents one-step count
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Derivative uses dt=0.1; rate and all durations are in SI seconds
edge_cases: invalid p; retreat begins before departure; no final commitment; low-speed stratum
rationale: For 3--4 m lane separation rate equals 0.45--0.60 m/s and fall equals 0.30--0.40 m

exact_formula: count disjoint median3-p episodes after p>=0.15 and before first commitment where dmedian3p/dt<=-0.10 per s for 3 frames and cumulative fall>=0.08
minimum_duration: 0.3 s negative-rate onset and 0.4 s minimum episode
hysteresis: enter at -0.10 per s; exit only after derivative>=0.04 per s for 3 frames; merge gaps below 0.4 s
expected_noise_sensitivity: Median3 reduces sample noise but can merge short genuine retreats
sampling_rate_sensitivity: All durations are physical seconds and derivative is recomputed after resampling
edge_cases: median boundary; overlapping retreats; p clipped at zero; no commitment
rationale: Lower threshold is paired with smoothing and longer persistence

exact_formula: count disjoint median5-p episodes after p>=0.20 and before first commitment where derivative<=-0.20 per s for 2 frames and cumulative fall>=0.12
minimum_duration: 0.2 s negative-rate onset and 0.3 s minimum episode
hysteresis: enter at -0.20 per s; exit only after derivative>=0.08 per s for 2 frames; merge gaps below 0.3 s
physical_interpretation: Conservative count of clear retreat rather than small waviness
expected_noise_sensitivity: Least sensitive to high-frequency jitter but may miss brief modest retreat
sampling_rate_sensitivity: All rates remain per second; median window scales with dt
edge_cases: median boundary; abrupt map-lane change; p saturation at zero
rationale: For 3--4 m lanes the required reverse speed is 0.60--0.80 m/s

exact_formula: sum max(delta_p-epsilon;0) divided by sum abs(delta_p) over departure through commitment
hysteresis: delta below epsilon ignored; denominator below 0.10 yields NOT_EVALUABLE
physical_interpretation: Share of realized transition displacement moving toward target
expected_noise_sensitivity: Small increments are thresholded to avoid numerical oscillation
sampling_rate_sensitivity: epsilon is tied to dt=0.1 and must be expressed as progress per physical second after resampling
edge_cases: zero denominator; no commitment; clipped p endpoints; invalid gaps
rationale: 0.01 progress is 0.03--0.04 m for 3--4 m lanes

exact_formula: 1 minus sum max(-delta_median3p-epsilon;0) divided by sum max(abs(delta_median3p)-epsilon;0) over departure through commitment
hysteresis: small signed increments ignored; denominator below 0.10 yields NOT_EVALUABLE
physical_interpretation: Penalty form for reverse movement after median smoothing
expected_noise_sensitivity: More robust to alternating frame noise but smoothing can hide a short retreat
sampling_rate_sensitivity: epsilon and median3 span must be converted using physical seconds
edge_cases: median boundary; denominator zero; no commitment; invalid p gaps
rationale: Separates magnitude of regression from overall progress after a short robust filter

exact_formula: proportion of valid transition intervals with dmedian5p/dt>=-0.05 per s after departure through commitment
hysteresis: interval qualifies only after median5; no additional state hysteresis
expected_noise_sensitivity: Insensitive to amplitude of small oscillations but sensitive to interval count
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Rate is SI per second and requires resampling before interval count
edge_cases: median boundary; no commitment; invalid p intervals; very short transition
rationale: Useful when clinical question is uninterrupted commitment rather than reverse distance
